detail.longDescription:
Thanks to everyone who joined my Microsoft Reactor livestream, and to @pamelafox@fosstodon.org, whose Part 1 code this demo builds on.

The demo is on GitHub. A coding agent writes fixes for a failing build. Each fix runs in its own sandbox, from a custom engine image with Java, Go, and Python. The sandbox's network log catches the fix that passes every test but tries to leak a secret. It runs on #Azure, or on your laptop with Docker.

Try it: https://aka.ms/code-execution-sandboxes

#AIAgents #AppSec
